summary: A dense SimpleTable of leads inside an already framed, horizontally scrolling panel: compact rows, two pinned columns, collapsible stage groups, a sortable Name header and clickable rows.
use: CRM or spreadsheet-like record lists that need many columns and rows: dense rows, pinned checkbox and name columns, grouped sections and keyboard-operable rows.
spec: `<SimpleTable density="compact" frame={false} scroll="none" stickyColumns={2} headerCase="sentence">` inside a caller-owned `overflow-x: auto` panel
`<TableSortHeader {sort} onsort={cycle}>` renders a sentence-case sortable header whose `sort` is `none`, `asc` or `desc`
One `<tbody>` per stage with `<TableGroupRow colspan={6} collapsible bind:open={opened[stage]}>` as its first row
`<TableRow selected={selected === l.id} onactivate=` rows: Tab, Enter/Space and click activate; the checkbox does not
The first two columns (checkbox, name) stay pinned while the panel scrolls sideways
